set.body: Outcome: assess all 108 unfinished baseline tickets against body, dependencies, current code and retained evidence; record completeness/correctness/staleness per ticket, make justified status/priority/dependency corrections, preserve live reservations and owner decisions, and select a bounded dependency-ordered tranche. Evidence: complete before/after snapshots, per-ticket decisions and source references, actual applied operations and integrity checks, and independent review. This planning audit does not execute study reads, model calls, publication, integration or the selected implementation work.
set.title: [planning] Reconcile every unfinished Mote and select the next tranche
